html:
SMTO-UI-0022 — This model setting is switched on but has no number

GUID: f2de688a-b20b-44df-a53a-cbf86b3adf12
Slug: ui-number-required
Domain: UI · Subsystem: ui

What happened

  • You switched on one of the model's number settings but left its box empty. SMTO didn't accept the change and kept the previous value.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. In Settings › Setup › Model routing, open the model (Main, Helper or Vision) and find the setting that has the message under it. The message appears right under the setting whose box is empty.
  2. Type a number into its box. If you're not sure what to use, open its Help and use the Explicit starting value. A switched-on setting must have a number so SMTO knows what to send to the model.
  3. If you don't need to set it, turn its switch off instead, then select Save for that model, such as Save Main. With the switch off, the model provider's own default is used and no number is needed.

What success looks like

  • The message under the setting disappears and the save shows Saved. New work will use this configuration.

If it still fails

  • Turn the setting's switch off to use the provider default, and send the copied error details to the person who manages SMTO's model setup.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • An enabled numeric model parameter override has a blank input, so the model configuration editor rejected the change.

What this means

  • An enabled numeric model parameter's input is blank. The shown control rejects this local action before its dependent submission. Earlier requests and saved state are unaffected by this validation result; server-side authority remains authoritative.

Why this can happen

  • An enabled numeric model parameter's input is blank.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the parameter's enabled state and marked input.

How to fix it

  • In model_configuration.js the input change handler throws ui_number_required when a number/integer parameter is configured but input.value is blank; the editor then reports hasErrors() and blocks saving. Enter a value that satisfies the parameter schema, or turn the parameter's User Configured switch off to fall back to the provider default.
  • Enter the supported value or deliberately turn this optional parameter off.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • The override has an intended supported value or is deliberately disabled.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • The shown control rejects this local action before its dependent submission. Earlier requests and saved state are unaffected by this validation result; server-side authority remains authoritative.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
